## Why

Goal 1: capture an open question with options and a recommendation in one
command.

## Files

- `internal/cli/cli.go`: register `init` and `ask`.
- `internal/cli/flags.go`: parsing of flags placed after positional arguments,
  and a repeatable string-list `flag.Value` (for `--option`, `--tag`).
- `internal/commands/init.go` and `internal/commands/ask.go`.
- `internal/cli/flags_test.go`, `internal/cli/init_test.go`,
  `internal/cli/ask_test.go`.

## Failing tests

End-to-end CLI tests call `cli.Run` in a fresh `t.TempDir()` store (with
`t.Chdir`, which rules out `t.Parallel`, or a root option the implementer adds
and records under C32), with a fixed clock where dates matter.

- `adj init` in an empty dir creates the store dir and the config and exits 0;
  a second `adj init` exits 0 and leaves existing records byte-identical.
- `adj ask "Title" --option a:"Use A" --option b:"Use B" --recommend a
  --key storage.engine --tag t1 --tag t2 --context "why"` creates one `open`
  record with those fields, `created` set from the clock and one history entry,
  and prints its ID.
- `--stdin` instead of `--context` reads the context from stdin.
- Flags after the positional TITLE are parsed (Go `flag` stops at the first
  non-flag argument, so `flags_test.go` covers this directly).
- A `--recommend` label that is not an option, an `--option` without `:`, and a
  duplicate option label each exit non-zero and write no file.
- `adj ask` before `adj init` exits non-zero and says to run `adj init`.
- `asked_by` is set from the source the implementer chose.

## Implement

1. One `flag.FlagSet` per subcommand; a helper that parses flags interspersed
   with positionals; the repeatable-flag type.
2. Commands take the clock (`func() time.Time`) from `cli`, so tests fix the
   date.
3. Follow the exit-code convention S02 recorded.
4. Implementer decides and records each of these (C32):
   - how `tradeoffs` are passed (PROJECT.md gives only `--option
     LABEL:SUMMARY`), for example `LABEL:SUMMARY:TRADEOFFS`, a separate
     `--tradeoffs LABEL:TEXT`, or file editing only;
   - how the recommendation's reasoning is passed, if at all;
   - how `asked_by` is supplied (flag, config or environment);
   - what `adj init` writes into the config.
